title: Fractured Mod
description: Mod for the Factions of Fractured Realms server
body:
Mod for the Factions of Fractured Realms server
# Features
- Fake Bedrock Block: looks just like real bedrock but has the same properties as stone, can be obtained from max level mason villager
- Fractured Sword: Sword that has the ability to open a portal to your own pocket dimension (same stats as netherite sword)
- Fractured Dust: When crafted with netherite sword creates the Fractured Sword, obtained when a player kills the warden
